name: SUNWAY
recent: Sunway 在2026年11月25日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，营收同比增长18%至30.27亿令吉，税前利润增长8.8%至5.185亿令吉，建筑订单创下124.5亿令吉纪录。同期，公司于11月6日召开特别股东大会，通过设立最多占已发行股本10%的雇员认股计划（ESOS）及相关配发决议。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）在11月多次申报持股变动。

recent_en: Sunway announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with revenue up 18% year-on-year to RM3,027 million, profit before tax up 8.8% to RM518.5 million, and a record construction order book of RM12.45 billion. In the same period, the company held an EGM on 6 November 2026 where shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and related allocations. Additionally, the Employees Provident Fund Board reported multiple changes in its shareholding in November.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results on 25 November 2026: revenue up 18% year-on-year to RM3,027 million, PBT up 8.8% to RM518.5 million, with a record construction order book of RM12.45 billion.
EGM on 6 November 2026 passed resolutions to establish an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and related allocations.
The Employees Provident Fund Board reported multiple changes in its shareholding in November 2026.
risks_en: The proposed ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares may lead to equity dilution.
An announcement on 19 November 2026 relates to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2,905.7 million, up 13.6% QoQ and 13.4% YoY; net income was RM318.6 million, down 96.6% QoQ but up 16.7% YoY; net margin was 11.0%, lower than 368.1% in the previous quarter.
